hero.title: People Safer together
hero.name: Banteay Digital / Digital Fortress
hero.description: Banteay Digital is an AI-powered platform focused on scam detection, digital safety, and community-driven fraud awareness. We bring analysis and shared knowledge together to help people make more informed decisions online.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Digital threats can look familiar.
problem.description: Scams, misleading content, suspicious links, and manipulated images are spreading across everyday digital life. A message can look genuine, a website can seem trustworthy, and an image can hide a different story.
problem.challenge: Everyday users need a quick way to assess unfamiliar content, understand the warning signs, and decide what to do next.

analysis.title: AI-assisted analysis
analysis.description: Examine text, links, screenshots, images, and decoded QR links for suspicious signals.

guidance.title: Risk assessment and recommendations
guidance.description: Receive an immediate assessment with practical guidance to help you respond carefully.

community.title: Community knowledge, reviewed
community.description: Report your encounter to help others. Administrators review community reports before publication.

objectives.label: Our Objectives
objectives.title: More awareness. Safer decisions.
objectives.description: Our goal is to help people understand digital information and turn that understanding into safer everyday habits.
objectives.literacy: Improve digital, media, and information literacy.
objectives.recognize: Help users recognize suspicious content and warning signs.
objectives.resource: Build a searchable resource for fraud awareness and shared learning.

workflow.label: How It Works
workflow.title: From uncertainty to a next step.

submit.title: Submit content
submit.description: Share the suspicious content you want to check, with private information removed.

analyze.title: AI analyzes
analyze.description: AI examines the content and identifies potential warning signs.

guidance.title: Receive guidance
guidance.description: Review the risk assessment and recommendations before taking action.

report.title: Report to community
report.description: Add your experience and submit a report for admin review.

team.label: Meet the Team
team.title: The people behind the fortress.
team.description: Seven members bringing software engineering, cybersecurity, and digital business together for a safer digital community.

context.label: Project Context
context.title: Learning with a purpose.
context.description: Banteay Digital was developed for the Next-Gen Engagement Program under the DMIL (Digital, Media, and Information Literacy) theme. The project connects what we learn with practical tools that help people navigate digital information more safely.
